query_evidence.query: can Instagram replace a website for a small business
query_evidence.interpretation: Evidence that small-business owners compare a social profile with a dedicated website; it is not verified demand, volume or difficulty.

editorial_decision.buyer_question: Can Instagram replace a website for a small business?
editorial_decision.distinct_task: Assign Instagram, the business website and direct messaging separate jobs across discovery, evaluation and enquiry instead of asking one channel to carry the whole journey.

limitations: The wording confirms that the question exists; it does not establish search demand or commercial value.
The article maps channel roles and does not repeat the existing Google Business Profile comparison or the enquiry-route guide.
The framework does not claim that any channel will produce visibility, followers, rankings or enquiries.
